headline: Mooring County Erupts as Northern Redoubts Trade Heavy Blows
war_summary: Since the midnight dispatch, combat operations have reignited sharply in Mooring County, where Colonial pushes captured positions at The Cut and The Wind Hills amidst more than two thousand casualties over the past two hours. Across Weathered Expanse, the bitter contest shows no sign of slackening; seven base transitions shook Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch in the latest two-hour interval, punctuated by continuous fighting right up to the wire. In Stonecradle, the ferocious slaughter of earlier hours has cooled into a grimmer, slower attrition, leaving lines stationary following late-night Warden captures at Buckler Sound and World’s End. Farranac Coast has similarly lapsed into a lull after earlier clashes, logging no strategic transfers over the last two hours. Along Callahan’s Passage and Stlican Shelf, heavy attritional fighting persists along unbroken borders, while surging enlistments in Linn of Mercy herald renewed friction. With central zones like Dead Lands remaining quiet, the war’s fury remains firmly pinned against the northern perimeter.
